# SAFE BD — "Peace of Mind" ### 60-Second Extended Brand Commercial (Apple Keynote Style) --- ## 🎬 Creative Brief & Production Overview - **Product:** SAFE BD (*National Citizen Safety, Covert SOS & Live Transit Protection Platform*) - **Founder / Presenter:** Saad Rizwan - **Format:** 60-Second Extended Narrative & Cinematic Brand Film - **Style:** **Apple Event Launch Film** (Minimalist elegance, cinematic macro cinematography, emotional human storytelling, dramatic orchestral/synth build, crisp typography) - **Visual Aesthetic:** Deep obsidian darks (`#090406`), sleek glassmorphic UI overlays, laser-crisp crimson accent pulses (`#ef4444`), warm anamorphic street bokeh of Dhaka at night. - **Soundtrack:** Starts with an intimate, pulsing sub-bass and solo piano chord (evoking vulnerability and suspense), transitioning at 0:20 into an uplifting, driving modern electronic-orchestral score (resonant brass, crisp ticking percussions, triumphant synthesizer swells). --- ## ⏱️ Timecoded Commercial Script (0:00 – 0:60) | Time | Visual / Shot Description | On-Screen Typography (SFX) | Voiceover (Narrator) | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **0:00 – 0:08** | **Cold Open — The Streets at Dusk.**
Cinematic slow-motion shot of Dhaka at twilight. Crowded sidewalk; neon signs reflecting off rain-slicked pavement. A university student steps onto a night bus; a healthcare worker walks down a dimly lit lane. Close-up on their faces—vigilant, cautious. | *Fade from Black*

`[Subtle city ambience: distant traffic, footsteps]` | *"Every day, millions of us step out into the world. Commuting late. Walking home from university. Navigating the unpredictable."* | | **0:08 – 0:17** | **The Critical Gap.**
Extreme close-up macro shot of a smartphone in hand. Suddenly, the camera whip-pans—the sound of an approaching motorbike. The screen shatters on asphalt. The phone screen turns off. Darkness. | `[Heartbeat sub-bass drops]`

`[Muffled impact sfx, silence]` | *"And in a crisis... voice calls aren't enough. When seconds matter, you can’t unlock a screen. And once a phone is taken... the evidence is lost."* | | **0:17 – 0:22** | **The Turning Point.**
